svg.aria-label: Animated diagram: a test flow built on the canvas is sent to the Express server, which starts a Playwright run with the chosen viewport, drives the storefront step by step, streams each step's status back over WebSocket to the canvas, captures a screenshot per step, compares captures with the baseline and turns failures into defect tickets
svg.title: How OmniFlow QA works
svg.text: A visual flow becomes a real Playwright run, streamed back to the canvas step by step

g.text: Build a checkout flow on the canvas and press Run
The server starts a Playwright run with the chosen viewport
Each node becomes a real browser step: search, add to cart, checkout
Step results stream back over WebSocket and the canvas lights up live
Every step is captured as a screenshot
The visual diff view compares each capture with its baseline
A failed step or visual change can be filed as a defect ticket
